rookery_new.name: rookery_new
rookery_new.description: Create a beat project, optionally seeded from a genre template and song key.

parameters.description: Create a beat project, optionally seeded from a genre template and song key.

name.description: New project name using letters, numbers, dot, underscore, or dash.

bpm.description: Tempo in beats per minute, from 30 to 300.

key.description: Optional song tonic pitch class; flats and sharps use the note spellings.

rookery_steps.name: rookery_steps
rookery_steps.description: Replace a track's repeating step pattern and optional per-step velocities.

parameters.description: Replace a track's repeating step pattern and optional per-step velocities.

name.description: Project name; omit to use the most recently updated project.

steps.description: Pattern using x for a hit and . for a rest; sample tracks may use slice digits. Length must divide the loop.

velocity.description: Optional repeating velocity values from 0 to 1.

rookery_track.name: rookery_track
rookery_track.description: Add, remove, or update a drum, bass, or sample track; set id master to edit tempo, bars, swing, or humanize_ms.

parameters.description: Add, remove, or update a drum, bass, or sample track; set id master to edit tempo, bars, swing, or humanize_ms.

name.description: Project name; omit to use the most recently updated project.

id.description: Track ID; use master with action set to edit project metadata.

source.description: Sound source such as factory:kick_boom, factory:808, or user:relative/path.wav.

steps.description: Optional initial pattern: x hit, . rest; sample one-shots may use slice digits. Length must divide the loop.

velocity.description: Optional repeating per-step velocity values from 0 to 1.

fx.description: Track FX chain; use rookery_mix to replace it later.

threshold_db.description: Compression threshold in dB, from -80 to 0.

ceiling_db.description: Output ceiling in dB, from -40 to 0.

threshold_db.description: Threshold in dB, from -40 to 0; use instead of ceiling_db.

delay_seconds.description: Delay time in seconds, from 0 to 10.

drive_db.description: Drive amount in dB, from 0 to 48.

centre_delay_ms.description: Centre delay in milliseconds, from 0 to 50.

cutoff_hz.description: Cutoff frequency in Hz, from 20 to 20000.

oneOf.description: Corvus FX: the VST3 the user configured as corvus_vst3_path. Add it to switch it on and set its named parameters; Rookery loads only that plugin and never downloads one.

params.description: Parameter names and numeric values exposed by the configured plugin (see rookery_kits).

pitch.description: Pitch offset in semitones from -48 to 48.

choke_group.description: Optional shared choke group for mutually exclusive drum voices; short string, drum tracks only.

role.description: Optional sample mix role; profile-derived when omitted.

mode.description: Sample playback mode: one-shot (default) or grid-locked loop.

key_lock.description: Transpose loop samples to the project key/scale when set, else the user's Flock harmony; defaults true in loop mode.

loop_bars.description: Override analyzed loop length in bars; 1, 2, 4, or 8.

duck.description: Kick duck depth for bass or loop sample.

notes.description: Bass notes; each item has a zero-based step, duration in steps, and MIDI pitch number or note name.

oneOf.description: Note name such as C1 or F#2.

slices.description: Number of equal slices for a sample track, from 1 to 10.

bpm.description: Project tempo, master only, from 30 to 300 BPM.

bars.description: Project loop length, master only; 4 or 8 bars.

swing.description: Project swing, master only, from 0 (straight) to 1 (full).

humanize_ms.description: Project humanization amount, master only, from 0 to 6 ms.

name.description: Project name; omit to use the most recently updated project.

fx.description: Ordered FX chain using built-in effects or an installed Corvus VST3.

rookery_apply.name: rookery_apply
rookery_apply.description: Apply a batch of edits in one revision, including a named drum groove, so a whole beat can land in one call.

parameters.description: Apply a batch of edits in one revision, including a named drum groove, so a whole beat can land in one call.

name.description: Project name; omit to use the most recently updated project.

ops.description: Ordered edits; each item has an op and that op's fields.

items.description: One edit. op selects the shape; the remaining fields match the single-edit tools.

op.description: Edit kind; balance measures the current loop and sets each audible track role to its target midpoint (no other fields).

track.description: Track ID for a steps edit, or the track to clear.

steps.description: Pattern: x hit, . rest; length must divide the loop.

id.description: Track ID for a track edit.

source.description: Sound source such as factory:kick_boom or user:path.wav.

notes.description: Bass notes with step, len, and pitch.

mode.description: Sample playback mode: one-shot or grid-locked loop.

key_lock.description: Transpose a loop sample to the project key; set false for unpitched audio.

loop_bars.description: Loop sample length in bars: 1, 2, 4, or 8.

choke_group.description: Shared choke group for drum voices.

role.description: Mix role for a sample track; omitted roles use the fetched sample profile when available.

duck.description: Kick duck depth for bass or loop sample.

target.description: master or a track ID for a mix edit.

fx.description: Ordered FX chain for a mix edit.

threshold_db.description: Compression threshold in dB, from -80 to 0.

ceiling_db.description: Output ceiling in dB, from -40 to 0.

threshold_db.description: Threshold in dB, from -40 to 0; use instead of ceiling_db.

delay_seconds.description: Delay time in seconds, from 0 to 10.

drive_db.description: Drive amount in dB, from 0 to 48.

centre_delay_ms.description: Centre delay in milliseconds, from 0 to 50.

cutoff_hz.description: Cutoff frequency in Hz, from 20 to 20000.

oneOf.description: Corvus FX: the VST3 the user configured as corvus_vst3_path. Add it to switch it on and set its named parameters; Rookery loads only that plugin and never downloads one.

params.description: Parameter names and numeric values exposed by the configured plugin (see rookery_kits).

bpm.description: Project tempo for a meta edit.

bars.description: Project length for a meta edit.

swing.description: Project swing for a meta or groove edit.

humanize_ms.description: Deterministic humanization amount in milliseconds, from 0 to 6.

key.description: Project tonic pitch class; flats and sharps use the note spellings.

groove.description: Named drum groove from skills/rookery/grooves.json; applied in the same batch.

sections.description: Arrangement sections for arrange; null removes arrangement.

rookery_render.name: rookery_render
rookery_render.description: Render and check the project. Loop snapshots include role balance, pairwise sample fit, and mix notes; song snapshots omit these loop-only fields.

parameters.description: Render and check the project. Loop snapshots include role balance, pairwise sample fit, and mix notes; song snapshots omit these loop-only fields.

name.description: Project name; omit to use the most recently updated project.

song.description: Render the arranged song instead of one loop.

rookery_export.name: rookery_export
rookery_export.description: Export a creator-ready soundtrack, stems, MIDI, and beat/bar/hit cue sheet. Other video-making agents can call this to get a soundtrack and cue sheet for a video, including frame cues for Remotion or After Effects.

parameters.description: Export a creator-ready soundtrack, stems, MIDI, and beat/bar/hit cue sheet. Other video-making agents can call this to get a soundtrack and cue sheet for a video, including frame cues for Remotion or After Effects.

name.description: Project name; omit to use the most recently updated project.

song.description: Export the arranged song; defaults to true when the project has an arrangement, otherwise false.

stems.description: Include aligned per-track and Flock WAV stems.

midi.description: Include a MIDI file with track and Flock notes.

fps.description: Add cue frame numbers at this frame rate, from 1 to 240.

rookery_state.name: rookery_state
rookery_state.description: Show the full human-readable project state, or changes since a retained revision.

parameters.description: Show the full human-readable project state, or changes since a retained revision.

name.description: Project name; omit to use the most recently updated project.

since.description: Return changes since this revision if it remains in history.

rookery_undo.name: rookery_undo
rookery_undo.description: Restore one or more history snapshots on a project.

parameters.description: Restore one or more history snapshots on a project.

name.description: Project name; omit to use the most recently updated project.

steps.description: Number of history changes to undo, from 1 to 128.

rookery_kits.name: rookery_kits
rookery_kits.description: List factory sounds, confined user-kit files, and Corvus availability.

parameters.description: List factory sounds, confined user-kit files, and Corvus availability.

rookery_samples.name: rookery_samples
rookery_samples.description: Search Soundza for lossless WAV loops and one-shots tagged with tempo, key and seamless looping, then import one as a normalized FLAC. A free Soundza key is needed to fetch; Openverse stays available as the CC0 lossy-preview source.

parameters.description: Search Soundza for lossless WAV loops and one-shots tagged with tempo, key and seamless looping, then import one as a normalized FLAC. A free Soundza key is needed to fetch; Openverse stays available as the CC0 lossy-preview source.

action.description: Search samples or fetch one by id, or batch up to four queries/ids.

source.description: Where to search: Soundza (lossless, royalty-free, needs a free key to fetch) or Openverse (CC0 MP3 previews). Defaults to soundza.

query.description: Words describing one sound to find; use instead of queries for a single search.

queries.description: Batch of 1 to 4 sound searches; results are returned in matching query groups.

kind.description: Optional sound kind: loop, one-shot, or texture. Soundza maps these to its form and type filters.

max_seconds.description: Optional maximum duration in seconds for search results.

limit.description: Maximum number of compact search results, from 1 to 20.

bpm.description: Optional target project tempo; Soundza searches within 6% of it and ranks fit.

key.description: Optional target project key for fit ranking.

id.description: One sound id from a search result; use instead of ids for a single fetch.

ids.description: Batch of 1 to 4 sound ids; each is fetched and quality-gated independently.
